name: Smart Food NY Inc.
old_description: We specialize in seamless foodservice supply, connecting quality products with businesses efficiently. And we’ve been doing it since 1982.
about:
Smart Food NY Inc. operates from Manhattan, New York, serving the New York metropolitan area. The business traces its roots to 1981 when it was founded as Smart Distributor, and it has been operating under the Smart Food NY name since 1982. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company functions as a wholesale food distributor and cash-and-carry supplier, offering same-day and next-day delivery across the metro region. It sources products both globally and locally, with perishable items procured from the tri-state area. Its catalog spans coffee and tea, eggs and dairy, drink supplies, food supplies, plastic and paper supplies, baking supplies, and aluminum supplies. A notable product is a custom Martinson coffee blend that has been served since 1951.

Customers include cafes, bakeries, grocery stores, supermarkets, offices, restaurants, and other distributors throughout the New York Metro Area. The company emphasizes consistent taste and service for both long-standing and new accounts.

Smart Food NY highlights competitive pricing without sacrificing quality, fast local delivery, and trusted products as its key differentiators. It began as a Chinatown wholesale food distributor and has maintained a focus on reliable supply for metro New York businesses.
